name: 28500-specdecode-gptoss120b-tp4
model: openai/gpt-oss-120b (target) + nvidia/gpt-oss-120b-Eagle3 (EAGLE3 draft head). Both public and ungated, 69 GiB and 412 MiB on disk, both already in this machine's HF cache. The target declares its own quantization: MX-format 4-bit expert weights with bf16 activations; the draft head is plain bf16.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node, one allocation.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1 -- the smallest split that keeps the MX-format expert dimension divisible on every rank. The draft head runs at the same tensor-parallel width.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 60 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. 45 requests are measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: 1024 prompt tokens in and exactly 1024 out with no length variance, plus `min_tokens: 1024` and `temperature: 0` in the request body. guidellm sets `max_completion_tokens` and `ignore_eos` itself, so no request can stop early.
purpose: A single-user long-form drafting assistant on a 120-billion-parameter model with speculative drafting, four GPUs, 1024-token replies.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- the parser DROPS nested blocks, and a dropped block would mean the
# engine runs without something this file declares. A bool is a FLAG: `true` emits `--key`,
# `false` emits nothing. Environment variables cannot live here.

model-path: openai/gpt-oss-120b
tp-size: 4

# The five speculative lines are the setup, not a tuning knob: without them the engine runs an
# ordinary autoregressive decode and this item measures something else. topk=1 makes the draft a
# linear chain, so three steps plus the bonus token is where draft-tokens=4 comes from.
speculative-algorithm: EAGLE3
speculative-draft-model-path: nvidia/gpt-oss-120b-Eagle3
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

# HAZARD: `speculative-eagle-topk: 1` also FIXES THE ATTENTION BACKEND. The default selection is
# `fa3` on sm90 for this non-MLA architecture only while the speculative top-k and the page size
# are both 1; raise either and it falls through to `triton`, because flashinfer does not serve
# attention sinks. A run that widens the tree must confirm and record which backend it got.

# Everything else is a stock default of the pinned commit. Two of those defaults are
# preconditions: the overlap scheduler must stay on, and CUDA graphs must stay on and capture the
# small batch this run lives at.
